(1) the VC dimension and the teaching dimension of acyclic CP net classes are equal to the number of nodes in the tree structure, and (2) there is an algorithm that learns the class of acyclic CP Nets with n nodes in O(n) time and O(n) queries.

the learning complexity parameters of classes of acyclic and of general CP nets can be characterized in the same way as for classes of boolean formulas, and that the learning complexity of classes of tree structured CP nets is lower than that of general acyclic CP nets.
the VC dimension of acyclic CP net classes is linear in the number of variables and that the teaching dimension is linear in the size of the largest tree in the CP net class.
